questions.answer:
Joe's AEO service page lists five parts of an AEO program:

- **Visibility baseline:** choosing the questions your buyers or patients ask and checking which brands each AI assistant cites today [3].
- **Content structure:** rebuilding pages around direct answers, question-based headings, and short self-contained paragraphs [3].
- **Entities and schema:** consistent organization, person, service, and medical schema, plus off-site signals that identify your business to AI systems [3].
- **Technical access:** AI crawler rules, server-rendered content, llms.txt, and page speed [3].
- **Reporting:** citation share across AI assistants, tracked monthly alongside your SEO numbers [3].

questions.answer: Keyword research remains fundamental to SEO, but this site says the approach has shifted from exact-match keywords toward user intent and conversational queries [4]. Practical steps include focusing on the specific problems your audience wants to solve, checking how people search on different platforms, and studying competitors' keywords to find content gaps [4]. Intent can be identified by examining current search results, the "People Also Ask" section, and keyword tools with intent classification [5].
